label: D2 after choosing a2 (mostly S2 common), strongest after an unrewarded trial, silent late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), when the agent has just chosen a2 (93% of mass; in_action==2 at D2), mostly on reaching S2 by a common transition (88% of mass on state S2). Never fires at D1 or GO, and almost never after a1. It goes silent late in the episode (none after trial ~90, little after 75), so ep_trial<75 is part of the predicate. Within a2 D2 steps it fires on only about a third, and history sets the magnitude: the largest activations come when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 62% of mass with 92% of top-quartile coverage), and the activation decays across runs of consecutive rewarded a2->S2 trials. Adding the recent-no-reward condition raises precision (about 0.50) but costs recall, so I recorded the simpler choice+phase+episode-time predicate (dev F1 0.49, mass recall 0.80). All variables are observed at D2.
